title: Chana bar Isak
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman places him in Rav Chisda’s time, as in [Ketubot 27b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.27b.11); see also the entry Mari bar Isak.[^1]

notes.text: The linked passage gives Mari and Chana as alternative names in the case brought before Rav Chisda. [Heilprin’s Mari bar Isak entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2394&lang=en) discusses that case and distinguishes a later Mari.
